critical_code_review_comments: NEW master-status endpoint at /api/upload/v2/master-status returns count and last_updated for sku_master, store_master, warehouse_master
UI redesign separates 'Master Data' (Setup Once) from 'Daily Transactional Data' (Upload Every Day)
Master Data section shows 3 cards with count, last_updated, download and upload icon buttons
Today's Status section shows 3 daily cards with Uploaded/Not Uploaded badges, time, and row count
'All daily data uploaded for today' banner appears when all 3 daily types are uploaded
Upload New Data section has Data Type dropdown with 6 options and react-dropzone file upload
Previous Days section shows grouped upload history
All data-testid attributes present for testing as specified in requirements
seed_data_creation: Test uploads created during testing are recorded in upload_history collection. Master data counts shown: SKU Master=0, Store Master=10, Warehouse Master=2
